description: Classifies and stratifies CPT data into geological layers based on predefined criteria and algorithms, facilitating geotechnical analysis and modeling.

execution_mode.description: The execution strategy for classify/stratify steps. When set to 'auto' the task decides automatically based on available memory.

oneOf.description: Dispatch each hole to a separate child task for parallel processing. Used when inline processing would risk an out-of-memory failure.
